# Mohamed Yaakoubi - AI Language Technology Specialist & Portfolio

> AI-Powered Solutions & Language Technology Specialist, Machine Translation Post-Editor, and AI Annotator & Evaluator based in Sfax, Tunisia.

## Overview
Mohamed Yaakoubi is an AI Language Technology Specialist and system builder based in Sfax, Tunisia. He works at the intersection of language, AI, and localization to help models and products scale across cultures. With hands-on evaluation experience for global clients (including Meta AI via RWS, Uber via Volga Partners, Unbabel, and Lionbridge), he specializes in Arabic-English AI evaluation, LLM prompt testing, multimodal annotation, and building high-performance web systems.

## Primary Projects
- [SheetDiff™](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/sheetdiff): High-precision Google Sheets data comparison add-on and diffing engine featuring cell-level diffing, fuzzy matching, and REST API integration.
- [Potential](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/potential): AI-driven career guidance and human potential discovery platform.
- [DocuMed](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/documed): Healthcare documentation and clinical record management system.
- [InternationalSkills](https://www.mohamedyaakoubi.com/en/projects/internationalskills): Global competency assessment and talent discovery platform.
